items.title: Ashen Lepus Hacker Group Attacks Eastern Diplomatic Entities With New AshTag Malware
items.description: A Hamas‑affiliated threat group known as Ashen Lepus, also tracked as WIRTE, has launched a new espionage campaign against governmental and diplomatic entities across the Middle East. items.title: Apache Struts 2 DoS Vulnerability Let Attackers Crash Server
items.description: A critical denial-of-service vulnerability has been discovered in Apache Struts 2, affecting multiple versions of the popular web application framework. The vulnerability, identified as CVE-2025-64775, exploits a file leak in multipart request processing that can cause disk exhaustion and server crashes. items.title: Windows Remote Access Connection Manager Vulnerabilities Let Attackers Escalate Privileges
items.description: Two critical privilege escalation flaws were disclosed in the Windows Remote Access Connection Manager on December 9, 2025. The vulnerabilities, tracked as CVE-2025-62472 and CVE-2025-62474, allow authorized attackers with low-level privileges to gain SYSTEM-level access on affected systems.
